chunks: He who finds the right path does so for himself; and he who goes astray does so to his own loss; and no one who carries a burden bears another's load. We never punish till We have sent a messenger.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about individual responsibility for guidance and bearing sins?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Al-Isra establishes the foundational Shia principle of individual accountability (mas'uliyyah), asserting that spiritual guidance or deviation yields consequences solely for the actor. It further clarifies the conditionality of divine punishment (ta'lif al-'adhab), noting that God does not punish until He has sent a messenger (rasul) to provide clear proof (hujjah), a concept deeply linked to the Imamate in Shia theology as the continuation of prophetic guidance.
